data.title: 菲伦 · 晨雾森林·法杖凝聚与极速魔法
data.description: 晨雾弥漫的古老森林深处，菲伦神情沉稳冷静地举起木质法杖，杖尖瞬间凝聚起耀眼而高密度的纯白魔法光弹。她眼神凌厉如刀，衣袍在魔力气流中翻滚——「芙莉莲大人教导过，普通攻击魔法只要速度足够快，就能击溃一切对手。请退后，猎物交给我来处理。」
data.promptProse: With her boots planted on the forest path, she holds the staff in both hands as a compact white sphere forms at its tip; its light reaches her focused face through the morning mist.
data.camera: full-body shot, staff tip and both hands visible
data.animaCaption: A compact white sphere forms at the staff tip above her planted boots.
